summary: Frontend-only testing of 'Mi Perfil' feature for vendedor role. The new /my-profile page works correctly - shows profile info, today's stats, week stats, and recent tickets. One minor display bug found: commission rate shows as empty (Comisión: %) because commission_rate field is not included in the user object returned by /api/users/me/profile endpoint.

minor.issue: commission_rate field not included in user object response. Backend uses user.get('commission_rate', 10) for calculations but doesn't add it to the returned user object

ui_bugs.issue: Commission rate displays as 'Comisión: %' (empty value) because profile.commission_rate is undefined. Should use fallback like (profile.commission_rate || 10)

action_items: Fix commission_rate display in my-profile.tsx by adding fallback: {profile.commission_rate || 10}% OR update backend /api/users/me/profile to include commission_rate in user object
